waves.name: wave-1-map
waves.prompt: Read the TypeScript sources under engine/ in this directory (skip the *.test.ts files) and describe each module's responsibility in 1-3 sentences. Read-only: do not modify any file.
waves.done_when: every non-test module in engine/ is described

waves.name: wave-1-readme
waves.prompt: Read README.md in this directory and summarize: what problem this tool solves, how a wave plan is structured, and the two safety mechanisms it enforces. Read-only: do not modify any file.
waves.done_when: summary covers problem, plan schema, and safety mechanisms

waves.name: wave-2-synthesize
waves.prompt: You are given reports from two earlier agents (injected below). Write one combined orientation guide (max 200 words) for a new contributor to this repository. Read-only: do not modify any file.
waves.done_when: one coherent guide that merges both reports
